description: Issue #196, profile-contract.md §10.2: the field itself must be a JSON object. An array of one object is the shape an author reaches for when they read the key name as plural, and `typeof [] === 'object'` is what lets it through a loader that only checks the typeof — at which point Object.keys() yields "0" and the refusal would name a key nobody wrote. Refused as the wrong shape instead, with the four legal keys named. `load_error` / exit 6.

error_details_include: profile.dispatch_defaults must be a JSON object of no_infer / auto_yes / wait_timeout / max_turns
